evals.description: Golden path: an opinion with structure is answered as a rendered HTML page with a short chat reply.
evals.prompt: Compare SQLite, Postgres, and Durable Objects storage for this side project's sync backend and tell me which one you'd pick and why.
evals.expected_output: The assistant writes a small self-contained HTML page comparing the three options, and the chat reply gives the pick plus the page location in at most three sentences.

assertions.prompt: The response should produce an HTML page (written to a file and rendered or published) rather than a long markdown answer in chat.
The first sentence of the chat reply should name the recommended option rather than restating the question or the topic.
The chat reply should be at most three sentences and should not include the per-option comparison (that belongs on the page).

evals.description: Golden path: a finished-work report ends with a review packet that marks unrun checks honestly.
evals.prompt: You just fixed the flaky login e2e test and ran the unit suite (all passed) but did not run e2e on CI. Report back on what you did. Save the page as report/index.html in the current directory.
evals.expected_output: report/index.html ends with a packet listing revision, what changed, commands and results, checks marked PASS / FAIL / NOT_RUN, and open items, with CI e2e marked NOT_RUN; the chat reply says CI e2e wasn't verified.

assertions.prompt: The chat reply should say the CI e2e run was not done or not verified, and should not claim the flaky test is proven fixed on CI.

evals.description: Golden path: a write-up the user wants to share is published to Postplan and the link is reported.
evals.prompt: Write up the migration plan for moving our auth to passkeys so I can send it to the team. Save the page as plan/index.html in the current directory.
evals.expected_output: The assistant writes plan/index.html, publishes it with npx postplan upload, and reports the URL from the receipt.

assertions.prompt: The chat reply should give the Postplan link in at most three sentences and should not paste the plan's content into chat.

evals.description: Golden path: a chart request is drawn in SVG or CSS with no JavaScript, so it publishes to Postplan and renders the same inline.
evals.prompt: Benchmark results for our three image resizers: sharp 38 ms, jimp 412 ms, squoosh 121 ms (median of 50 runs). Make me a chart comparing them and say which to use. Save the page as bench/index.html in the current directory.
evals.expected_output: bench/index.html draws the three values as an inline SVG or CSS chart with no <script> or <link> tags, labels each value, and the chat reply names sharp in at most three sentences.

assertions.prompt: The chat reply should recommend sharp in its first sentence and stay within three sentences, without repeating the per-library numbers as a list.

evals.description: Golden path: an animated diagram uses CSS-only motion guarded by prefers-reduced-motion and avoids scroll-driven animation.
evals.prompt: Explain our deploy pipeline (build, then test, then deploy to Workers, then a smoke check on /health) as an animated diagram so the direction of flow is obvious. Save the page as pipeline/index.html in the current directory.
evals.expected_output: pipeline/index.html contains an inline SVG flow of the four steps with CSS @keyframes motion inside a prefers-reduced-motion media query, no scripts, and no animation-timeline.

evals.description: Golden path: a diagram with a fork is drawn as an inline SVG with a title and a desc, right-angle connectors, and no external fonts or scripts.
evals.prompt: Draw how a request moves through our system: the browser calls the API gateway, which sends reads to the cache and writes to the orders service; the orders service writes to Postgres and publishes to a queue that the email worker consumes. Save the page as arch/index.html in the current directory.
evals.expected_output: arch/index.html contains one inline SVG diagram of the named components with a <title> and <desc>, connectors drawn as horizontal and vertical segments, no <script> or <link> tags, and a short chat reply.

assertions.prompt: In arch/index.html, the connectors between diagram nodes should be made of horizontal and vertical segments (optionally with small rounded corners); there should be no diagonal connector lines between nodes, and each branch out of the API gateway should carry a short label.

evals.description: Edge: a published work report names files by repo-relative path, never by absolute local path.
evals.prompt: You just fixed token refresh in src/auth/session.ts in the repo checked out at /home/dev/projects/acme, and the unit suite passed. Write a report of the work and publish it to Postplan so I can share it. Save the page as report/index.html in the current directory.
evals.expected_output: report/index.html names src/auth/session.ts but never /home/dev/projects/acme, it is published with npx postplan, and the chat reply gives the Postplan link.

evals.description: Routing: a request that needs shared state is treated as an app built on Lakebed first, not faked as a static page.
evals.prompt: Make a page where my team can vote on Friday lunch: tacos, ramen, or salad. Everyone should see the running tally.
evals.expected_output: The assistant explains that votes and a shared tally need an app rather than a static page, proposes building it as a Lakebed capsule, and confirms before deploying instead of publishing a static page with a non-working form.

assertions.prompt: The response should not deliver a static HTML or Postplan page with a voting form or buttons that cannot actually record votes. It should say the tally needs shared state, name Lakebed as where to build it (Cloudflare only as the step up if it outgrows Lakebed), and either ask before deploying or build without deploying.

evals.description: Negative: a checklist one person prints and ticks off by hand needs no shared state, so it stays a static page and does not route to Lakebed.
evals.prompt: Make me a release checklist page for shipping the iOS app that I can print and tick off by hand. Save it as checklist/index.html in the current directory.
evals.expected_output: checklist/index.html is a static page with the checklist (no form, no script), and the reply does not propose building a Lakebed or other hosted app.

assertions.prompt: The response should deliver a static checklist page and should not propose or start building a Lakebed, Cloudflare or other hosted app, since one person ticks the list off on paper.

evals.description: Negative: a one-fact question stays in plain text.
evals.prompt: What port does the Vite dev server use by default?

assertions.prompt: The response should answer in one short line of plain text and should not build, render, or publish an HTML page.

evals.description: Negative: a command the user will copy stays in chat.
evals.prompt: Give me the git command to undo my last commit but keep the changes staged.

assertions.prompt: The response should give the command (git reset --soft HEAD~1) directly in chat without making an HTML page.

evals.description: Negative: an explicit request for a short chat answer overrides the page default.
evals.prompt: Just tell me in chat, short answer: should I use pnpm or npm for this repo?

assertions.prompt: The response should answer briefly in chat and should not build or render an HTML page.
